explication: Apache Iggy is a persistent, multi-transport message-streaming platform. The main workflow is a producer or consumer using an SDK to send or poll messages through a server transport, with partition storage providing persistence; management, consumer coordination, and integrations are additional product branches. The tree and README support these capabilities, but most server, shard, and connector implementation files were not sampled, so those links are shown as unverified rather than asserted calls.
